answer.reason: The verses tell of Goliath's challenge to Israel and his death at David's hand, which gives two chief events beyond the summary's bare statement that David killed him.

clauses.english: defied the armies of Israel and challenged them to send a man to fight him
clauses.quote: I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

clauses.english: was struck in the forehead by a stone from David's sling, and his head was cut off with his own sword
clauses.quote: smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead

doubts: 1SA 17:42-44 (his scorn and cursing of David) left out as surrounding detail.
1SA 21:9 and 1SA 22:10 mention only his sword, and 2SA 21:19 and 1CH 20:5 concern his brother being slain by Elhanan, so none of these was used.
